news.analysis: Washington had a ridiculous 17 targets on Sunday, by far the most he's seen in a game this year. He had a controversial play late in the game where he bobbled a potential touchdown, appeared to secure it and get his feet in bounds, but was ruled incomplete because Washington had not yet completed possession. It's a tough break for the breakout receiver, but he's now had back-to-back 100-yard games and gets the Titans next week.

news.analysis: Herbert tossed a pair of touchdowns to Ladd McConkey while adding a 10-yard rushing touchdown in the close loss. He suffered a concussion late in the game and entered the league's concussion protocol after the contest ended. He is unlikely to play in Week 12 vs. the Patriots, putting DJ Uiagalelei in line to make the start. Uiagalelei has completed two of his seven pass attempts this season for 24 yards and a touchdown. Stay tuned to the Chargers' practice reports this week.
news.contents: Justin Herbert completed 15 of his 21 passes for 131 yards and two touchdowns while adding eight rushes for 32 yards and a touchdown in a 27-24 loss to the Jets in Week 11.
news.title: Justin Herbert throws two TDs, suffers concussion late in Week 11 loss

news.contents: Los Angeles Chargers quarterback Justin Herbert is in the concussion protocol, according to Noah Furtado. Herbert played through the Chargers' final offensive snap in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the New York Jets, hitting Ladd McConkey for a six-yard touchdown with 2:01 left. He completed 15 of 21 passes for 131 yards and two touchdowns with no interceptions and added 32 yards and a touchdown on eight carries. The Chargers host the New England Patriots on Nov. 29. news.analysis: Taylor had pretty much his worst game of the season Thursday night, as the Colts were dominated in all facets by the Texans. The star running back is stuck in an impotent offense with a team that is now 3-8 and looking to the future. Better games should still lay ahead, but the Colts may also decide to ease off Taylor's usage down the stretch.

Dell moves forward as a volatile, big-play receiver for fantasy purposes.
